## History

Melisande was an imaginary young girl created in Nell's mind during her time at Mrs. Rudge's place. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) pictured the source of a sound as Melisande, leading her to imagine the two of them becoming wonderful companions.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/melisande--nell-harcourt.md)

Melisande serves as an imaginary, echoed-voice companion to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in a glen. Beyond this phantom presence, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) interacts primarily with other locals, such as attending a tea hosted by Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md) alongside [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) Bradley and reporting the evening's events back to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Nell Is Invited Out to Tea P1](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Nell Is Invited Out to Tea P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), +2 more_
